stage0088b_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$桂$$
「...So you're saying $$エンジェル$$
　was Paradigm City's very existence itself?」

stage0088b_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$ゴードン・ローズウォーター$$
　speculated as much.」

stage0088b_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$デュオ$$
「A city's existence being one person...」

stage0088b_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$ヒルデ$$
「I don't really understand it, but...」

stage0088b_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Even she herself didn't understand
　why she was Paradigm City's memory.」

stage0088b_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「But knowing the weight of her mission,
　the truth of their existence, and the future,
　she drove her own heart into isolation...」

stage0088b_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$トロワ$$
「So as a result, she tried to choose
　to forget everything, is that it?」

stage0088b_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$五飛$$
「That's a denial of the world...
　erasing Paradigm City itself...」

stage0088b_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$桂$$
「So that's the system this 'Taiji' thing prepared...」

stage0088b_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$カトル$$
「Thanks to Mr. $$ロジャー$$'s persuasion,
　she embraced the present and let go of the past.」

stage0088b_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$デュオ$$
「That had me sweating for real.
　If Paradigm City had vanished like that,
　who knows what would've become of our world.」

stage0088b_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$カトル$$
「Next, it's our turn to break through
　the eternity we were made for...
　the Prison of Time.」

stage0088b_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「But it seems $$シャア・アズナブル$$
　intends to decide humanity's future before that.」

stage0088b_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$桂$$
「Settle things before the $$エタニティ・フラット$$
　announcement, then seize control after...」

stage0088b_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$桂$$
「Unbelievable...
　With all that trouble waiting,
　and he still wants to be humanity's leader.」

stage0088b_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$トロワ$$
「That must be that man's resolve.」

stage0088b_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$五飛$$
「Not that I can accept something like that.」

stage0088b_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
（$$シャア$$...
　the future you saw in the Zero System...
　is this battle the answer to that...）

stage0088b_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「What is it, $$ドロシー#240$$?」

stage0088b_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$ドロシー#240$$
「What happened to $$エンジェル$$?」

stage0088b_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「I don't know.
　But I believe we'll meet again.」

stage0088b_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$ドロシー#240$$
「When she returns to Paradigm City?」

stage0088b_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「...At this point, I don't know
　what's become of that city...」

stage0088b_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「But somewhere in the world, I'll meet her.」

stage0088b_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「No, it's not, $$ドロシー#240$$.
　This is a promise.」

stage0088b_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「A promise... in other words, a request.
　And I always see a request through.
　That's a professional's pride.」

stage0088b_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$ドロシー#240$$
「$$ロジャー$$ the Negotiator...」

stage0088b_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Yes... as long as I remain a negotiator,
　the show that is my life goes on.
　With the world as my stage.」

stage0088b_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$ロジャー$$
（Isn't that right, $$エンジェル$$...）

stage0088b_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah, Master $$ノーマン$$...
　Master $$ロジャー$$'s performance this time
　was truly something to behold.」

stage0088b_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$ノーマン$$
「Indeed.
　Master $$ロジャー$$'s negotiation
　saved the world.」

stage0088b_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No, no... what I mean to say
　isn't about that, but about this other matter.」

stage0088b_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$ノーマン$$
「What do you mean by 'this other matter'...」

stage0088b_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A full sweep of $$ビッグデュオ$$, $$ビッグファウ$$,
　and $$ビッグオー$$! In mahjong terms, that's a grand slam!」

stage0088b_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Wasn't Master $$ロジャー$$ aiming for that too?
　In fact, you've produced 100 Z-Chips.
　Ah, of course, I've added those to the squad's stock.」

stage0088b_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$ノーマン$$
「I'm sorry to interrupt your joy,
　but I believe it's best that word of this
　never reaches Master $$ロジャー$$'s ears.」

stage0088b_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$ノーマン$$
「Unless you'd like to share the same fate
　as the Big, that is.」

stage0088b_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh, you're joking.
　Even Master $$ロジャー$$, better with his fists
　than his words, wouldn't go that far...」

stage0088b_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$ノーマン$$
「No, I will be the one dealing with you.」

stage0088b_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$ノーマン$$
「Removing anything that displeases my master
　is also a butler's duty.」

stage0088b_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$ドロシー#240$$
「What are you doing, $$ノーマン$$?」

stage0088b_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$ノーマン$$
「Ah, $$ドロシー#240$$... good timing.
　Mr. $$ＡＧ$$ seems to misunderstand
　Master $$ロジャー$$, so I mean to protest a little.」

stage0088b_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$ノーマン$$
「Shall we begin then, Mr. $$ＡＧ$$?」

stage0088b_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（M-my memory... it might get wiped
　by physical impact...）

stage0088b_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$スズネ$$
「What were you doing in Paradigm City?」

stage0088b_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$スズネ$$
「While we were fighting,
　I heard from $$アストナージ$$ and $$チェーン$$
　that you'd gone out, Mr. $$ＡＧ$$.」

stage0088b_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Were you perhaps chasing after Geminis?」

stage0088b_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Well, if I've been found out, so be it.
　I too want to know the truth behind
　$$ガドライト$$'s $$ジェミニア$$ and $$ジェニオン$$'s resemblance.」

stage0088b_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No... I couldn't find Geminis,
　and more than that, I had my hands full
　just escaping that $$ビッグヴィヌス$$.」

stage0088b_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I heard from $n
　that you and the others met $$ガドライト$$.」

stage0088b_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I heard Miss $$アンナロッタ$$ said that man
　and $n look alike, and...
　I thought the same thing, too...」

stage0088b_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I can't put it well, but...
　I think he's carrying something inside too.」

stage0088b_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Geminis's circumstances mean nothing to me.
　They're scum who started a war on Earth
　through cowardly means.」

stage0088b_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And that's not all.
　For $n, they're the enemy who took his family.」

stage0088b_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If you carelessly show sympathy to those guys,
　it'll be you and $n who end up dead.」

stage0088b_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$スズネ$$
「You're right...
　It's just as you say...」

stage0088b_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As long as you understand, that's fine.
　I'm always praying for the safety
　of $n and you, Miss $$スズネ$$.」

stage0088b_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then, let's shift gears and go with a bang!
　Let's give it our all today too!」

stage0088b_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（That's right, Miss $$スズネ$$...
　$$ジェニオン$$ has to defeat $$ジェミニア$$.）
